title: portfolio-map-3d site config (site/site.json)
description: Who publishes the map and what it calls things. scripts/validate-site.mjs checks this file before every build; docs/configuration.md explains every field.

id.description: The map's id in the Portfolio Map Network: registry/instances/<id>.json.

shareDescriptions.description: Share company descriptions in the public manifest the Nexus reads (its cross-network search uses them).

name.description: The organization that publishes the map.

website.description: Its website; the top bar's logo links there.

logo.description: Its logo for light grounds, a file in site/brand/ (e.g. "brand/logo.svg"); null shows the name in type.

logoOnDark.description: Its logo for dark grounds (the dark theme); null uses `logo`.

title.description: The map's name: the page title and the link-preview title.

tagline.description: One short line the Nexus shows under the map's name.

description.description: One or two sentences for search engines and link previews.

url.description: The https address the map is deployed at, no trailing slash.

directoryUrl.description: Where the full list lives without JavaScript (the noscript note).

notice.description: A one-line notice in the About panel and above the list (e.g. "Example data").

hub.description: The name on the hub building at the center of the walk world.

accent.description: Links, focus rings, the second accent and the hub's band. 4.5:1 or more on white.

ctaText.description: Text on the call-to-action fill: 4.5:1 or more against it.

ink.description: The brand's dark ink: label text, the dark logo plate. 7:1 or more on white.

enabled.description: Live explorers in the walk world (needs a Supabase project: docs/live-explorers.md).

channel.description: The Realtime channel's base name; production joins <channel>-v1, other builds <channel>-preview.

walk.description: The walk world's optional parts; each is on unless set to false (docs/walk-world.md).

village.description: The houses, street lamps and bunting around the plaza, with the plaza's fountain, market stalls, ice-cream cart, kiosk and bike rack.

setPieces.description: The set pieces on the coast and the hills between the districts: true for every kind, false for none, or a list of the kinds to use (src/views/walk/pieces.ts).

keepsakes.description: Keepsakes hidden by the set pieces for visitors to find, and their counter.

wildlife.description: Gulls, butterflies, motes of light, a hot-air balloon and a cat.

sound.description: The sound button: the world's synthesized sound, off until a visitor turns it on.
